issues.claim: "Параметры настройки и устранение неполадок провайдера Azure Key Vault..." / "...configuration and troubleshooting options"
issues.problem: The fetched page title is only "...Configuration Options". Troubleshooting is a separate AKS page, so the link title overstates what the page covers. The page itself does support rotation (enableSecretRotation, rotationPollInterval 2m), secretObjects sync and objectAlias.
issues.suggestedFix: Retitle to "Параметры настройки провайдера Azure Key Vault для Secrets Store CSI Driver в AKS" and "Azure Key Vault provider for Secrets Store CSI Driver in AKS: configuration options".

issues.claim: A Kubernetes `Secret` is a way to deliver a value to a Pod. Where is the master copy of the secret then, who rotates it, and who sees that it was accessed?
issues.problem: The hint comes close to stating the central point of the answer: the master copy belongs in an external store with rotation and audit. A candidate is nudged straight to the conclusion. It is still a nudge, not the full answer.
issues.suggestedFix: Weaken it, for example: "Which problems does a `Secret` object not solve once several teams use it: where does the value live, how is it rotated and how is access audited?"

issues.claim: Managed services (AKS, EKS) run the control plane and offer automatic upgrades
issues.problem: AKS has auto-upgrade channels. EKS has no equivalent for the control plane in general, apart from EKS Auto Mode and forced upgrades at the end of support. Putting AKS and EKS together slightly overstates what EKS offers.
issues.suggestedFix: Write: "Managed services (AKS, EKS) run the control plane, and AKS offers auto-upgrade channels, but the team still owns upgrade planning and testing, node pool upgrades, add-ons, policies and observability in every cluster." Mirror this in the ru text.
